decision: The competitor (McLaren Mastercard F1 Team) is fined €5,000. This fine is suspended for a period of 12 months subject to no further breach of a similar nature.
fact: The driver was late attending the Thursday Press Conference
offence: Breach of Article B10.1.1.a of the FIA F1 Regulations and Articles 12.2.1.i and 12.2.1.p of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 1 (Lando Norris) and the team representative. The driver explained he was delayed at a previous commitment. Noting that in accordance with Article 9.15.1 of the FIA International Sporting Code, the Competitor is responsible for the actions of its driver, the penalty is imposed on the Competitor.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 1 Media Commitment
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Mastercard F1 Team
